messages.subject: Legend justification and positioning
parts:
Hi folks,

I know thats kind of an old topic and I know that the proper
justification/positioning of the legend is on your todo list Hadley. I
just want to know if there exists a workaround to center the vertical
legend (at the right hand side) on the plot NOT including the x axis
text.

Code to illustrate my problem:

---
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(mtcars, aes(row.names(mtcars),mpg,colour = qsec)) +
geom_point() +
opts(axis.text.x=theme_text(angle=90,hjust=1))
---

With theme_text() I am able to manually adjust the y label to be
centered. But what can I do to get the legend centered?

Any ideas?

Thanks.

Patrick
